fusions.name: Threaded Needle
fusions.desc: Drives one stiffened strand into a target up to 6 tiles away for 4 piercing damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the strand tied on, [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Running Stitch
fusions.desc: Sends a strand through the first enemy it meets for 26 piercing damage, then on through 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each taking 60% of that. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Nimble Plaiting
fusions.desc: Your strands take over the drilled motions of your hands, increasing your attack speed by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Rote Knotwork
fusions.desc: Every ability you use ties another knot in your hair: a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
